mock_data.title: Going on a Diet
mock_data.passage:
2 March 2002

Dear Pam,

You know how I said that I was never again going to go on a diet. Well, I take it all back. Here I am again, counting calories and eating little more than lettuce leaves.

It's all Polly's fault. She's getting married in July and she's asked yours truly to be her bridesmaid. That's very nice, of course, especially since the wedding's going to be in New York. The fly in the ointment from my point of view is that Polly is so slim. Not only that, but the other bridesmaid is Polly's sister, Jane, who is just as slim. However much I try to slim, I'm going to look like the back end of a bus beside them, but I feel I have to try.

My mother's not helping because she keeps worrying about my becoming anorexic—as if!—and telling me that I'm looking far too pale. As if this wasn't bad enough, my Gran's visiting us just now and my Gran's cooking is to die for. I've had to take to eating on my own and cooking for myself. I just cannot bear to have to watch the rest of the family tucking into Gran's homemade pies while I am toying with a little steamed broccoli. If I did all, my diet plans would go out the window.

So life's not exactly a bowl of cherries at the moment. I have to get up with the lark so that I can have my meager breakfast before Gran appears to start cooking bacon and sausages or making pancakes. My mother tries to stop her because she's worried about Dad's cholesterol, but for Gran that kind of cooking is the habit of a lifetime and she just ignores Mum's advice. Naturally, my father and brother love these huge breakfasts! So would I!

I take a packed lunch—salad and a bottle of water—and eat in the park, if it's not pouring with rain. The rest of the office are getting very suspicious and apparently some of them think that I have a new man in my life and I'm rushing out to meet him. I wish!

I'm sorry if this letter is all about food. That's because I rarely think of anything else these days. I find myself thinking that I could murder a steak when, usually, I rarely eat red meat.

Much love
Alice
mock_data.passageB1:
Dear Pam,

Remember when I said I would never go on a diet again? Well, I was wrong. I am counting calories and not eating very much.

It's all because of Polly. She is getting married in July, and she wants me to be a bridesmaid. That's nice, because the wedding is in New York. But Polly is very slim. And the other bridesmaid, Polly's sister Jane, is also slim. I will probably look very big next to them, but I want to try to lose weight.

My mother is not helping. She is worried I will become too thin and tells me I look pale. Also, my grandma is visiting, and her cooking is amazing! I have to eat alone and cook for myself. I can't watch everyone else eating her homemade pies while I eat steamed broccoli. If I did, I would forget about my diet.

Life is not easy right now. I have to wake up very early to eat my small breakfast before Grandma starts cooking bacon and sausages or making pancakes. My mother tries to stop her because she is worried about Dad's cholesterol, but Grandma always cooks like that. My father and brother love these big breakfasts! I would too!

I take a packed lunch – salad and water – and eat in the park if it's not raining. My work friends are starting to think I have a new man in my life and I am meeting him. I wish!

I am sorry this letter is only about food. I don't think about much else these days. I really want to eat a steak, even though I don't usually eat much red meat.

Much love,

Alice
mock_data.passageB2:
Dear Pam,

Remember how I declared I'd sworn off dieting forever? Well, forget I said that. Here I am again, obsessively counting every calorie and basically living on lettuce.

It's all Polly's doing. She's getting married in July and has asked me to be a bridesmaid. Which is lovely, especially since the wedding is in New York. The slight hitch, however, is that Polly is incredibly slim. And to make matters worse, the other bridesmaid is her sister, Jane, who is equally slender. Realistically, no matter how hard I try, I'm going to feel out of proportion standing next to them, but I feel I have to make the effort.

Mum's not exactly helping matters. She keeps worrying I'll become anorexic – as if! – and saying I look too pale. As if that wasn't enough, Gran's visiting and her cooking is simply irresistible. I've had to resort to eating alone and preparing my own food. I simply can't bear watching everyone else devouring Gran's homemade pies while I'm picking at a bit of steamed broccoli. If I did, my diet would go out the window.

So, life's not exactly a bed of roses at the moment. I have to get up at the crack of dawn to eat my meagre breakfast before Gran starts cooking bacon and sausages or making pancakes. Mum tries to stop her, worried about Dad's cholesterol, but Gran's been cooking like this her whole life and she just brushes off Mum's concerns. Naturally, Dad and my brother love these huge breakfasts! I would too!

I take a packed lunch – salad and water – and eat it in the park, weather permitting. The others at work are getting suspicious. Apparently, some think I have a new boyfriend and I'm sneaking out to meet him. If only!

I apologise if this letter is all about food. It's just that it's constantly on my mind these days. I even find myself craving a steak, which is uncharacteristic of me, as I rarely eat red meat.

Much love,
Alice
mock_data.passageC1:
Dearest Pam,

Remember my emphatic declaration about eschewing diets for good? Well, consider it retracted. Here I am, once again, embroiled in the tedious ritual of calorie counting and subsisting on what feels like a perpetual salad.

It's all Polly's doing, really. She's getting married in July and, much to my surprise, has asked me to be a bridesmaid. The prospect is undeniably lovely, especially given that the wedding is slated to take place in New York. However, the rub, from my perspective, is Polly's inherently slender physique. Compounding this is the fact that the other bridesmaid is Polly's sister, Jane, who is equally svelte. While I acknowledge that I'm unlikely to ever achieve their lithe figures, I feel compelled to make a concerted effort, lest I resemble an unwieldy vehicle standing beside them.

My mother's well-intentioned anxieties are proving to be less than helpful; she's constantly voicing concerns about me developing anorexia – an absurd notion, frankly – and remarking on my increasingly pallid complexion. As if that weren't enough, Gran is currently visiting, and her culinary creations are, quite simply, irresistible. I've been forced to resort to eating in solitude and preparing my own meals. The mere thought of watching the rest of the family devour Gran's homemade pies while I nibble on a portion of steamed broccoli is enough to send my dietary resolve spiraling into oblivion.

Consequently, life is not exactly a bed of roses at present. I'm compelled to rise before dawn to consume my meager breakfast before Gran commences her daily ritual of cooking bacon and sausages or preparing pancakes. My mother attempts to dissuade her, citing concerns about Dad's cholesterol levels, but for Gran, this style of cooking is a deeply ingrained habit, and she simply dismisses Mum's advice. Unsurprisingly, my father and brother are relishing these substantial breakfasts! As would I!

I meticulously prepare a packed lunch – salad and a bottle of water – and consume it in the park, weather permitting. My colleagues are becoming increasingly suspicious, and apparently, some of them suspect that I have a clandestine romance and am rushing out to meet my new beau. If only!

I apologize if this letter is entirely centered around food; it's simply that I find myself preoccupied with little else these days. I've even experienced an inexplicable craving for steak, despite rarely consuming red meat under normal circumstances. It's as if my body is rebelling against the deprivation.

Much love,
Alice

questions.answer: Answers will vary. Students might discuss personal attempts to lose weight, challenges faced, motivation (health, appearance, events), methods used (calorie counting, exercise, specific diets), and whether they found it difficult or easy.
questions.question: Talk about your own experience of dieting or a friend's experience.

questions.answer: Answers will vary. Common feelings include: hungry, deprived, irritable, obsessed with food, tempted by favorite foods, proud of willpower, tired from lack of energy, motivated by progress, or frustrated by slow results.

questions.answer: Answers will vary. Success might be measured by: weight lost, ability to maintain the diet, improved health markers, whether goals were achieved, long-term vs. short-term results, or overall satisfaction with the experience.

mock_data.translation:
2 mart 2002

Hurmatli Pam,

Bilasanmi, men hech qachon yana parhez qilmasligimni aytgan edim. Xo'sh, men hamma gapimni ortga olaman. Mana, men yana kaloriyalarni sanab, sabzot barglaridan boshqa deyarli hech narsa yemayapman.

Bu hammasi Pollining aybi. U iyul oyida turmushga chiqadi va mening o'zimni uning ko'ylagichi bo'lishga taklif qildi. Bu, albatta, juda yoqimli, ayniqsa to'y Nyu-Yorkda bo'ladi. Mening nuqtai nazarimdan muammosi shuki, Polli juda ozg'in. Nafaqat shunday, balki boshqa ko'ylagichi Pollining singlisi Jeyn ham xuddi shunday ozg'in. Qanchalik ozg'inlashishga harakat qilsam ham, ularning yonida avtobusning orqa tomoni kabi ko'rinaman, lekin harakat qilishim kerakligini his qilaman.

Onam yordam bermayapti, chunki u mening anoreksiaga chalinishimdan xavotirlanib, menga juda rangpar ko'rinayotganingni aytadi—xuddi shunday bo'lsa! Xuddi bu yetarli emasdek, buvim hozir bizga tashrif buyurishgan va buvimning taomi hayotim uchun fido bo'laman darajasida. Men yolg'iz ovqatlanishim va o'zim uchun taom tayyorlashim kerak bo'ldi. Men oilaning qolgan a'zolarining buvimning uy piroglarini yeyishini tomosha qilishga chidolmayman, men esa bug'langan brokkoli bilan o'ynab o'tirsam. Agar buni qilsam, mening parhez rejalarim derazadan uchib ketadi.

Shunday qilib, hayot hozirda unchalik yoqimli emas. Men erta turishim kerak, shunda buvim bekon va kolbasa pishirishni yoki kreplar tayyorlashni boshlashidan oldin o'zimning kichkina nonushtamni yeya olaman. Onam uni to'xtatishga harakat qiladi, chunki u otamning xolesterinidan xavotirlanadi, lekin buvim uchun bunday ovqat tayyorlash bir umrlik odat va u onamning maslahatiga e'tibor bermaydi. Tabiiyki, otam va akam bu katta nonushtalarni yaxshi ko'radilar! Men ham shunday qilardim!

Men o'zim bilan tushlik olib boraman—salat va bir shisha suv—va parkda yeymen, agar yomg'ir yog'mayotgan bo'lsa. Ofisning qolgan xodimlari juda shubha bilan qarashmoqda va ko'rinishidan ularning ba'zilari menda yangi erkak bor deb o'ylashadi va uni uchrashuv uchun shoshilayapman. Qanchalik yaxshi bo'lardi!

Agar bu xat faqat ovqat haqida bo'lsa, kechirasiz. Buning sababi shuki, men bu kunlarda boshqa narsani deyarli o'ylamayman. Men bifshteksni o'ldirishim mumkin deb o'ylayapman, garchi odatda qizil go'sht kamdan-kam iste'mol qilaman.

Mehr bilan
Elis

mock_data.translationB1:
Qimmatli Pam,

Esimda bo'lsa, men hech qachon yana parhez qilmayman degan edimmi? Xullas, men xato qilgan ekanman. Men hozir kaloriyalarni hisoblayapman va juda kam ovqat yeyapman.

Buning hammasi Polly tufayli. U iyul oyida turmushga chiqyapti va meni kelin dugonasi bo'lishimni xohlaydi. Bu yaxshi, chunki to'y Nyu-Yorkda bo'ladi. Ammo Polly juda ozg'in. Va Pollyning singlisi Jeyn ham ozg'in. Men ularning yonida juda katta ko'rinishim mumkin, lekin men vazn tashlashga harakat qilmoqchiman.

Oyam yordam bermayapti. U meni juda ham ozib ketishimdan xavotirda va rangim oqarganini aytyapti. Bundan tashqari, buvim mehmon bo'lib kelgan, va uning taomlari ajoyib! Men yolg'iz ovqatlanib, o'zimga ovqat tayyorlashim kerak. Boshqalar uning uyda tayyorlangan piroglarini yeyayotganini tomosha qilib, men dimlangan brokkoli yeyishim mumkin emas. Agar shunday qilsam, men parhezimni unutaman.

Hozir hayot oson emas. Men buvim bekon va sosiska pishirishni yoki blinchik tayyorlashni boshlashidan oldin kichkina nonushtamni yeyish uchun juda erta turishim kerak. Oyam dadamning xolesterinidan xavotirda bo'lgani uchun uni to'xtatmoqchi bo'ladi, lekin buvim har doim shunday pishiradi. Dadam va akam bu katta nonushtalarni yaxshi ko'rishadi! Men ham yaxshi ko'rardim!

Men o'zim bilan tushlik olib yuraman – salat va suv – va agar yomg'ir yog'masa, parkda ovqatlanaman. Ishdagi do'stlarim meni hayotimda yangi odam paydo bo'lgan deb o'ylashni boshlashdi va men u bilan uchrashyapman deb o'ylashyapti. Qaniydi shunday bo'lsa edi!

Kechirasiz, bu xat faqat ovqat haqida. Men bu kunlarda boshqa narsa haqida o'ylamayapman. Men chindan ham biftek yegim kelyapti, garchi men odatda qizil go'shtni ko'p yemayman.

Sevgi bilan,

Alisa
mock_data.translationB2:
Salom Pam,

Eslaysanmi, men umrbod parhez qilmaslikka qasam ichganimni e'lon qilgandim? Xullas, uni unut. Mana men yana, har bir kaloriyani obsesif tarzda hisoblayapman va asosan salat bargi bilan kun kechiryapman.

Bularning hammasi Pollining ishi. U iyulda turmushga chiqyapti va mendan kelinoy bo'lishimni so'radi. Bu ajoyib, ayniqsa to'y Nyu-Yorkda bo'lishini hisobga olsak. Kichik to'siq shundaki, Polli juda ozg'in. Va vaziyatni yanada yomonlashtiradigan narsa, boshqa kelinoy uning singlisi Jeyn, u ham xuddi shunday nozik. Haqiqatan ham, qanchalik harakat qilmayin, ularning yonida tursam, proportsiyam buzilgan holda turganimni his qilaman, lekin men harakat qilishim kerak deb o'ylayman.

Oyim vaziyatni unchalik yaxshilayotgani yo'q. U doimo men anoreksik bo'lib qolishimdan xavotirda – go'yo! – va men juda rangim oqarganini aytadi. Xuddi shu kamdek, buvim mehmon bo'lib kelgan va uning taomlari shunchaki qarshilik ko'rsatib bo'lmas darajada. Men yolg'iz ovqatlanishga va o'zimga ovqat tayyorlashga majbur bo'ldim. Boshqalarning buvimning uy sharoitida tayyorlangan piroglarini ishtaha bilan yeyishini tomosha qilib, men bir bo'lak dimlangan brokkoli bilan ovqatlanishga toqat qilolmayman. Agar shunday qilsam, mening parhezim shamolga sovuriladi.

Demak, hayot hozirda gullab-yashnagan bog' emas. Men buvim bekon va kolbasa pishirishni yoki pankek tayyorlashni boshlashidan oldin, erta tongda turib, arzimas nonushtamni yeyishim kerak. Oyim otamning xolesterini haqida xavotirlanib, uni to'xtatishga harakat qiladi, lekin buvim umri davomida shunday ovqat pishirgan va u shunchaki oyimning xavotirlarini e'tiborsiz qoldiradi. Tabiiyki, otam va akam bu katta nonushtalarni yaxshi ko'radilar! Men ham xohlardim!

Men tushlikka – salat va suv – olib ketaman va ob-havo imkon bersa, uni parkda yeyman. Ishdagi boshqalar shubhalana boshladilar. Shekilli, ba'zilar mening yangi yigitim bor deb o'ylashadi va men u bilan uchrashish uchun yashirincha chiqib ketyapman. Qani endi shunday bo'lsa!

Agar bu xat faqat ovqat haqida bo'lsa, uzr so'rayman. Shunchaki, bu kunlarda doimo mening xayolimda. Hatto men go'shtli biftekni juda xohlayman, bu men uchun xos emas, chunki men kamdan-kam hollarda qizil go'sht yeyman.

Sevgi bilan,
Alisa
mock_data.translationC1:
Aziz Pam,

Eslab qol, men umuman dieta qilmaslik haqida qat'iy bayonot bergandimmi? Xo'sh, uni bekor qilingan deb hisoblang. Mana men, yana bir bor, kaloriya hisoblashning zerikarli marosimiga aralashib, doimiy salatga o'xshash narsa bilan kun kechirmoqdaman.

Bularning barchasi aslida Pollining ishi. U iyul oyida turmushga chiqyapti va, meni hayratda qoldirib, meni kelin o'rtog'i bo'lishimni so'radi. Bu istiqbol, ayniqsa to'y Nyu-Yorkda bo'lib o'tishi rejalashtirilganini hisobga olsak, inkor etib bo'lmaydigan darajada yoqimli. Biroq, mening nuqtai nazarimdan muammo shundaki, Polli tug'ma nozik qomatga ega. Bunga qo'shimcha ravishda, boshqa kelin o'rtog'i Pollining singlisi Jeyn bo'lib, u ham xuddi shunday qaddi-qomatli. Men ularning ingichka qomatlariga hech qachon erisha olmasligimni tan olsam-da, ularning yonida noqulay transport vositasiga o'xshab qolmaslik uchun astoydil harakat qilishga majburman.

Onamning yaxshi niyatli xavotirlari unchalik yordam bermayapti; u doimo men anoreksiyaga chalinib qolishim haqida xavotir bildiradi - ochig'ini aytsam, bu bema'nilik - va mening tobora oqargan yuzim haqida gapiradi. Go'yo bu yetmagandek, buvim hozir mehmon, va uning pazandalik ijodlari shunchaki rad etib bo'lmas. Men yolg'izlikda ovqatlanishga va o'z ovqatlarimni tayyorlashga majbur bo'ldim. Qolgan oilaning buvimning uyda tayyorlangan piroglarini yutayotganini, men esa bir qism dimlangan brokkolini kemirayotganimni tomosha qilish fikrining o'ziyoq mening parhezga bo'lgan qat'iyatimni yo'qotish uchun yetarli.

Natijada, hayot hozirda ayniqsa gulzor emas. Men buvim bekon va kolbasa pishirish yoki blinchik tayyorlashning kundalik marosimini boshlashidan oldin tong otmasdan turishga majburman va o'zimning ozgina nonushtamni yeyman. Onam dadamning xolesterin darajasi haqida xavotir bildirib, uni qaytarishga harakat qiladi, lekin buvim uchun bu pishirish uslubi chuqur o'rnashgan odatdir va u shunchaki onamning maslahatini rad etadi. Ajablanarlisi shundaki, dadam va akam bu to'yimli nonushtalardan rohatlanishyapti! Men ham xuddi shunday qilardim!

Men ehtiyotkorlik bilan tushlik tayyorlayman - salat va bir shisha suv - va ob-havo imkon bersa, uni parkda iste'mol qilaman. Mening hamkasblarim tobora shubhalanib bormoqda va ko'rinishidan, ularning ba'zilari menda maxfiy ishqiy munosabat bor va yangi sevgilim bilan uchrashish uchun shoshayapman deb gumon qilishadi. Qani endi shunday bo'lsa edi!

Agar bu xat butunlay ovqat haqida bo'lsa, uzr so'rayman; shunchaki, men o'zimni bu kunlarda boshqa hech narsa bilan band qilolmayapman. Men hatto odatda qizil go'shtni kamdan-kam iste'mol qilsam ham, biftekka tushunarsiz ishtiyoq sezdim. Go'yo mening tanam mahrumlikka qarshi isyon ko'tarayotgandek.

Katta muhabbat bilan,
Alisa
